title: Demo: Anti-lock braking system
text: An anti-lock braking system (ABS) helps prevent wheels from locking during hard braking so the driver can retain steering control. It does not guarantee a shorter stopping distance in all conditions.

title: Demo: Automatic emergency braking
text: Automatic emergency braking (AEB) may detect an imminent collision and apply brakes automatically. Performance varies with road, weather and sensor conditions; drivers must remain attentive.

title: Demo: Blind spot monitoring
text: Blind spot monitoring may alert drivers when another vehicle is detected alongside them. It does not replace mirror checks or looking over the shoulder.
